sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next at full 262k context on 8 GB RAM and 16 GB VRAM—20 tok/s generation and 1,600 tok/s prefill. Direct-from-SSD expert offloading for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (125B MoE, 512 experts). Most setups for this model require 48–64 GB of system RAM just to hold the expert weights in memory.

sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next features a 125B -parameter main model, supplemented by an additional 51B N-gram embeddings, with 6B parameters activated per token.
